steps.note: The first line make prints on a fresh clone: there is no .env, so the example's key names are copied. Every empty key then takes its development default from docker-compose.yml. With a .env already there, make prints nothing for it.

output: for p in sdk-dotnet/Endgame.AppKit sdk-dotnet/Endgame.AppKit.Testing dev/Endgame.AppKit.DevPlatform; do \
MSBuildEnableWorkloadResolver=false DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 dotnet pack $p -c Release --nologo || exit 1; done
cd sdk-web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm pack --pack-destination ../template/vendor/npm
steps.note: make up runs this itself, because Dock's image carries the app kit's template. These are the recipe lines make echoes. The pack and npm output between them is left out, and so is the line that clears the NuGet cache.

Compose builds the seven images (that output is left out), then waits until every service with a health check reports healthy. On a first run the network and volumes are created as shown. http://localhost:8095/ then serves the console.
